# ymfm vendored source

This directory contains the minimum upstream `ymfm` files needed by the
portable YM3812 renderer. They were copied without functional modification
from <https://github.com/aaronsgiles/ymfm> commit
`81aec25ccbb98f4873a255f7551ac4dadac59b4a` (retrieved 2026-08-03).
